"GTA 6 LITE: GAME SCRIPT (UPDATED)

- Intro @COMMENT_BODY@ Branding: \"Five Star Games\" branding on intro and loading screens.
- Localization: 8 countries (Pakistan, USA, India, China, Bangladesh, Turkey, Iran, Saudi Arabia) with strict real-location lock.
- Real-World Sync: Live synchronization of time, date, and weather.
- Camera Angles: Full multi-angle camera support (Cinematic, First-person, Third-person, Drone/Aerial, and Director modes).
- Phones: Lucia uses Realme 5 (rear-sensor) and Jason uses Infinix Smart 9 (side-button).
- Showroom Inventory: Custom Blue-Pink Fade Ferrari, Camouflage Corvette C8, Orange Track Hypercar, Classic Green Lowriders, and civilian Flying Tesla with chasing Police Flying Tesla.
- Building Posters @COMMENT_BODY@ Active Workers: Massive custom game billboards on city buildings, featuring realistic workers actively pasting and painting the posters on scaffolding platforms.
- Hospital: Interactive hospital with patient clothes, IV drips, and medical fees.
- Police @COMMENT_BODY@ Jail: Inmate uniforms, voice-controlled fine payment (\"Pay fine\") or 3-hour wait option.
-Game Title: GTA 6 LITE
Startup @COMMENT_BODY@ Dual-Option Verification Sequence:
​On launch, the game displays \"Five Star Games\" intro branding styled similarly to classic cinematic developer splash screens.
​Startup Verification Screen with Two Options:
​Option 1 (Top Field): Allows the user to enter their Email address along with their Date of Birth (Day, Month, and Year).
​Option 2 (Bottom Black-Themed Field): Designed for users who wish to skip or do not know how to enter an email, allowing them to proceed by entering only their Date of Birth (Day, Month, and Year).
​Age Restriction Rule: If the user is 18 years or older, the game proceeds. If under 18, it displays a bright red warning screen on-screen and strictly blocks gameplay.
Loading Animation @COMMENT_BODY@ Safehouse Spawn:
​Followed by a stylish neon glowing startup and cinematic loading screen sequence.
Country Selection, Dynamic Language Localization @COMMENT_BODY@ Dialogues:
​Post-loading, a country selection menu appears featuring 8 locked regions: Pakistan, USA, India, China, Bangladesh, Turkey, Iran, and Saudi Arabia.
​Dynamic Language @COMMENT_BODY@ Dialogues: Selecting a country automatically configures the game's text, system UI, and all character voice lines/dialogues (from small to major interactions) to that specific local language (Pakistan/India: Urdu/Hindi, USA: English, Turkey: Turkish, China: Chinese, Saudi Arabia: Arabic, Iran: Persian, Bangladesh: Bengali). NPCs walking on roads converse in these localized languages, interact, and dynamically react/talk to or scold the player in the chosen language.
​Upon selecting the country, the player automatically spawns inside that specific country's designated Safehouse.
Core Mechanics, Driving, HUD Layout @COMMENT_BODY@ Real-World Synchronization:
​Open-world environment featuring a realistic mix of paved main roads, paved alleys, unpaved dirt roads, and unpaved dirt alleys across selected countries.
​Real-World Live Synchronization: The game's time, date, and weather conditions (such as live rain, storms, night, morning, and evening) automatically sync and reflect real-life conditions in real time.
​Screen HUD Layout (UI Design):
​Top Left HUD: Displays the active character's Health Bar indicator.
​Top Right HUD: Displays real-time Vehicle Speedometer (Car/Bike Speed) when driving.
​Bottom Left HUD: Displays the 4-directional Mini-map layout with pink GPS route navigation.
​Bottom Right HUD: Displays dynamic Lucia @COMMENT_BODY@ Jason avatar photo icons for quick character switching.
​World @COMMENT_BODY@ Safehouse Lighting Control: At exactly 6:00 PM in the evening, all public and commercial lights across the game map (shops, petrol pumps, railway stations, streets) automatically turn ON, and they automatically turn OFF at exactly 7:00 AM in the morning. In contrast, the characters' (Lucia and Jason) Safehouse lights and appliances are entirely manually controlled by the player using an in-house switch panel featuring 3 interactive buttons: 1) Fan ON/OFF, 2) Lights ON/OFF, and 3) AC ON/OFF.
​Full multi-angle camera support including Cinematic, First-person, Third-person, Drone/Aerial, and Director modes.
​Driving Mechanics: Implements realistic vehicle driving physics and handling mechanics inspired by GTA IV.
Asset @COMMENT_BODY@ Memory Budget Specifications (Total 16 GB):
​Driving Mechanics Allocation: 2 GB
​Graphics Allocation: 1 GB
​Vehicles Asset Allocation: 1 GB
​Characters Asset Allocation: 2 GB
​Character Torso/Body Detail Allocation: 2 GB
​Character Face/Mouth Detail Allocation: 2 GB
​Road Textures Allocation: 500 MB
​Miscellaneous Small Details Allocation: 500 MB
​Open-World Map (including 4-directional Mini-map @COMMENT_BODY@ GPS route), Extra Character Details @COMMENT_BODY@ Environment Allocation: 6 GB
Characters, Devices @COMMENT_BODY@ Smartphone Communication System:
​Playable Characters @COMMENT_BODY@ Devices: Playable characters Lucia and Jason. Lucia uses a Realme 5 smartphone (with rear-sensor details), and Jason uses an Infinix Smart 9 smartphone (with side-button details).
  
​Interactive Smartphone Dialers @COMMENT_BODY@ Contacts: Both smartphones feature fully functional call dialers and contacts applications configured exactly as shown in reference media. Each character's phone contacts list specifically stores only the other's contact details (Lucia's phone contains only Jason's number, and Jason's phone contains only Lucia's number). Players can initiate calls either by manually typing numbers into the call dialer or by selecting the respective contact.
  
​GTA 6 Style Avatar Switcher UI: Features small clickable avatar photos of Lucia and Jason positioned in the bottom right corner of the HUD screen. Tapping Lucia's photo icon instantly switches camera control and spawns the player as Lucia at her active world position, while tapping Jason's photo icon seamlessly spawns and switches active gameplay to Jason.
Vehicles, Showrooms, Fuel @COMMENT_BODY@ Interactive Racing Track System:
​Showroom inventory featuring custom cars based on photo references: Blue-Pink Fade supercar, Camouflage Corvette C8, Orange Track Hypercar, Classic Green Lowriders, and civilian Flying Teslas pursued by Police Flying Teslas.
​Interactive Mixed-Terrain Racing Track @COMMENT_BODY@ Reward/Disrepute Mechanics: Features a massive racing track marked with a designated Pink Waypoint. Interacting with the marker opens an interactive menu allowing players to choose from various Bikes and Cars for high-stakes racing across paved roads, paved alleys, dirt roads, and dirt alleys. Winning a race awards monetary cash prizes, while losing results in a loss of street reputation and disrepute.
​Realistic vehicle fuel consumption system where cars run out of fuel and require refueling at petrol pumps.
​Unpaved Road/Alley Dirt Mechanics @COMMENT_BODY@ Car Wash/Modding: Driving vehicles on unpaved dirt roads or dirt alleys—especially after rainfall—causes thick mud to stick heavily to the tires and vehicle body. This mud remains permanently attached until the player takes the car to a dedicated Car Modify @COMMENT_BODY@ Wash Garage, pays the service fee, and gets the car and its tires washed clean. The garage also allows full car customization and modifications.
World, Interiors @COMMENT_BODY@ Interactive Furniture Locations:
​30-Second Countdown Proximity Mechanics: Standing close to any seating object (chairs, sofas, benches) or sleeping furniture (beds/cots) displays a 30-second countdown overhead. Upon timer completion, the character automatically transitions into the sitting or sleeping animation. Sitting restores stamina, while sleeping fully refills health and stamina alongside advancing in-game time.
​Full Building Entry, Flats @COMMENT_BODY@ Advanced Elevator System: All buildings feature fully accessible interior flats reachable via stairs and interactive elevators. Elevators include a side control panel with a red button to close doors and a touch interface with floor buttons (1 through 12) to select specific floors, as well as a dedicated \"Last Floor\" option to transport the player directly to the building's rooftop. Inside flats, NPCs are seen watching TV or carrying out daily chores.
​Interactive Activities, Dynamic Rain Accumulation @COMMENT_BODY@ Street Life: Rain causes water accumulation on paved streets and paved alleys, while unpaved dirt roads and alleys become muddy and dry naturally over time. Following rainfall, worker NPCs physically open street manhole (gutter) covers, use wipers to sweep accumulated water into the drains over a simulated time period, close the covers back up, and leave. NPCs can also be seen walking on streets and alleys, talking, reacting/scolding the player in the selected local language, and playing basketball on courts where players can join in.
​Gun Shop for purchasing weapons and gear.
​Food @COMMENT_BODY@ Drink Shop with interactive mechanics allowing players to buy items or perform stealth/direct thefts.
​Fuel Stations / Petrol Pumps for vehicle refilling.
​Advanced Railway System: Featuring exactly two distinct railway stations across the map and a total of two active trains—Railway Station 1 features an outgoing train departing away from the player, and Railway Station 2 features an incoming train arriving towards the player with full animations.
​City buildings featuring massive custom game billboards, complete with active worker NPCs realistically pasting and painting posters on scaffolding platforms.
Police, Wanted System, Hospital @COMMENT_BODY@ Jail:
​10-Star Wanted @COMMENT_BODY@ Police Pursuit System: Committing crimes triggers up to 10 Star wanted levels, causing aggressive police units and police stations to actively deploy and chase the player.
​Police and Jail System: Includes fully modeled Police Stations, inmate uniforms, and an interactive voice-controlled fine payment system (\"Pay fine\" voice prompt option) or a 3-hour wait option.
​Interactive Hospital System: Features patient clothes, IV drips, and medical fee mechanics.gta 6 lite game script (final combined)
